description: Fifty saved primary-analysis epidemic/protection pairs sampled with seed 20260928, retaining slide 25’s ten examples first, to illustrate scenario-specific optimal dates.
calendar_alignment: Each protection curve is shifted to its own scenario-optimal vaccination week. The matching red dot marks the dose date, before the saved immune-response delay.
epidemic_alignment: State 4 normalizes these fifty epidemic curves to equal AUC and shifts them to maximize shared area with a representative profile chosen from the epidemic curves alone. Optimal-date dots move with their curves; summary statistics describe only these fifty examples.
regret_definition: Remaining burden at a candidate date minus the minimum remaining burden in that same scenario.
